issues.detail: The candidate matches the recorded 56-byte append slice: tail reload occurs after writing node.prev; empty append sets both endpoints to the appended address; full raw EAX is preserved, including a node at offset zero.

The candidate matches the recorded 44-byte pop slice: successor reload, branch-specific writes and raw initial-head return are preserved. Removed-node bytes remain unchanged under the disjoint-object preconditions.

Unsigned address arithmetic is defined and bounded by the contracts. GuestMemory uses bounded little-endian byte accesses with shifts of 0, 8, 16 and 24, avoiding host alignment and pointer-aliasing assumptions. Supplied module/RVA/slice identities and verified source/contract/reference bindings support this scoped review; raw and canonical hash domains are appropriately distinguished.

limitations: Approval covers only src/linked_structures.cpp with raw SHA-256 4abf407b00dae915390634bbcd079e25ab2d6ccda58a65909ea434aca475b5a5 under the frozen bounded contracts; registry integration is not approved.
Original ECX preservation, nonvolatile registers and ret4/ret0 behavior are supported by instruction evidence and emulator checks. The C++ offset API is not a tested x86 ABI bridge.

Reported validation ran native arm64 C++ against Unicorn-executed x86 slices on macOS using AppleClang 21. All 772 positive cases passed; negative controls produced the expected 256 append and 240 pop mismatches. This is finite corpus evidence, not native Windows reference validation or proof of universal equivalence.

Overlap, malformed graphs, reinsertion, wrapping addresses, alternate bases, faults, MMIO, concurrency, allocation, event handling and whole-game behavior remain excluded. Sequence evidence covers captured prestates rather than live candidate composition.
Review used only the supplied material; hashes and executions were not independently recomputed.
review.summary: Approve the scoped source package. Instruction-level review finds no discrepancy in control flow, full return bits, memory footprints, access order or defined C++ semantics within the frozen contracts.

integration_transition.change: Only the two package function statuses change from contracted to implemented. All identity, ABI, source, contract and backend fields remain identical.

scope: Independent text-only source review after automatic deterministic gates. Final checkout validation is recorded separately.
